harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-23, before any result of this arm was read (borg-zoo#750, Experiment A, redo of the arm `nodear`). The first `nodear` (reborn-abl-*) set town_prepared_poison 0, below that parameter's range 1-20, and the binary rejected the configuration in every cell; no result of it exists. Two arms on track-p 13151fb5: ctl (shipped) and nodear (the #1134 additions off: town_prepared_poison_percent 0, i.e. the poison remedy at the shared town_prepared_percent 8 instead of 40, and town_prepared_ccw 0, i.e. no Cure Critical Wounds row of their own). The older town_prepared_* rows stay on in both arms.
Tier verysmall: classes-1800 starts 1-45, 100,000 turns.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; identical plays per arm (an arm that plays ctl's keys was not exercised). Report per arm against ctl: deaths and causes (exact McNemar), deaths at CL <= 2, DL3 and DL5 reached, mean CL, per class. Descriptive (RULES 14).
